extracted.intended_audience: state agencies engaged in Florida rulemaking and members of the public seeking rules/notices
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance about the Department of State’s Administrative Code & Register functions for filing, publishing, and providing access to Florida agency rules and related notices under Chapter 120, Florida Statutes. Covers the publishing media (Florida Administrative Code and Florida Administrative Register) and types of rule-development notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency rulemaking governed by Chapter 120, Florida Statutes (Administrative Procedure Act)
rubrics_metrics.description: Agency rulemaking is governed by Chapter 120, Florida Statutes, the Administrative Procedures Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies must follow the procedures and requirements set out in Chapter 120 when promulgating rules. The Department of State’s Administrative Code and Register Section is the filing point for rules promulgated by state regulatory agencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rules published in the Florida Administrative Code (FAC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Final agency rules are published in the Florida Administrative Code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Department’s program is responsible for ensuring rules are published in the FAC (access via flrules.org). For questions regarding the content, interpretation, or application of a specific rule, contact the agency that created the rule (a directory of state agencies is available online).

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of rulemaking notices in the Florida Administrative Register (FAR)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Administrative Code and Register Section publishes the Florida Administrative Register, which contains notices related to rule development and other agency actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Register is the official medium for publishing notices such as Notices of Proposed Rule, Notices of Rule Development, and Agendas for Hearing. Agencies file notices with this program for publication in the FAR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice types required/used during rule development
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard notice categories identified for rule development include: Agenda for Hearing, Notice of Proposed Rule, and Notice of Rule Development (see Chapter 1-1, F.A.C. Rule Development - 2026).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These notice types are the typical filings published in the Register to inform the public and to satisfy procedural requirements under the Administrative Procedure Act. Agencies should use the appropriate notice type consistent with Chapter 1-1 F.A.C. guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section mission and responsibilities (filing, preservation, public access, consultation)
rubrics_metrics.description: The mission of the Administrative Code and Register Section is to file, preserve, and make available to the public the rules, laws, notices, and other public records it receives, and to provide continuing access to materials that have long term value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section staff provide consultation to guide state agencies with respect to the requirements for filing rules and publishing notices. They also serve as the public access point for those records. Contact information (office location, mailing address, telephone, fax, and e-mail) and the flrules.org link are provided for filings and inquiries.
